message: The workspace sandbox exposes .agents/ and .git as read-only submounts, so the required gate scripts cannot be patched and logical commits cannot be created in this checkout; rerun with write access to those paths.

notes: Root-caused: Codex sandbox hard-protects .agents/ (agent-config dir class, like .codex/ and .git) at both patch and seatbelt layers. Resolution: machinery renamed .agents/ -> factory/ (decision 0016); factory/ is confirmed writable. Resume implementation against factory/ paths; commits remain the orchestrator's.
